crossRefs.note: Behold, he will kill me. I have no hope. Nevertheless, I will maintain my ways before him.
Examine me, Yahweh, and prove me. Try my heart and my mind.
But let a man examine himself, and so let him eat of the bread, and drink of the cup.
Examine your own selves, whether you are in the faith. Test your own selves. Or don’t you know about your own selves…
The unfaithful will be repaid for his own ways; likewise a good man will be rewarded for his ways.
But with me it is a very small thing that I should be judged by you, or by man’s judgment. Yes, I don’t judge my own…
For I know nothing against myself. Yet I am not justified by this, but he who judges me is the Lord.
For our boasting is this: the testimony of our conscience, that in holiness and sincerity of God, not in fleshly wisdom…
And by this we know that we are of the truth, and persuade our hearts before him,
For even they who receive circumcision don’t keep the law themselves, but they desire to have you circumcised, that…
The Pharisee stood and prayed to himself like this: ‘God, I thank you that I am not like the rest of men…
Now I mean this, that each one of you says, “I follow Paul,” “I follow Apollos,” “I follow Cephas,” and, “I follow…
Is Christ divided? Was Paul crucified for you? Or were you baptized into the name of Paul?
Therefore let no one boast in men. For all things are yours,
Now these things, brothers, I have in a figure transferred to myself and Apollos for your sakes, that in us you might…
For who makes you different? And what do you have that you didn’t receive? But if you did receive it, why do you boast…
But what I do, that I will do, that I may cut off occasion from those who desire an occasion, that in which they boast…
For such men are false apostles, deceitful workers, masquerading as Christ’s apostles.

translations.web: But let each man examine his own work, and then he will have reason to boast in himself, and not in someone else.
translations.bsb: Each one should test his own work. Then he will have reason to boast in himself alone, and not in someone else.
translations.kjv: But let every man prove his own work, and then shall he have rejoicing in himself alone, and not in another.
translations.asv: But let each man prove his own work, and then shall he have his glorying in regard of himself alone, and not of his neighbor.
